nima: 4 dyuymli sensorli ekran, Android tizimi, rus tilidagi interfeys
1996-yildan keyingi, 16 kontaktli OBD-II uyasi bor barcha markalarda ishlaydi
Xato kodlarini o‘qiydi va o‘chiradi; mashinaga kabel bilan ulanadi
qayerda: Toshkent va viloyatlardagi avtoservislarda hamda avtohavaskorlarda: «Check Engine» chirog‘i yonganda sababini bir necha daqiqada ko‘rsatadi.
ustun: Autel MaxiSys Ultra ga nisbatan ko‘p marta arzon va cho‘ntakka sig‘adi
Ultra barcha elektron bloklarni va elektromobil batareyasini tekshiradi — CRE916 bitta tizim bilan ishlaydi
mat: O‘zini oqlash muddati: T = Narx ÷ kunlik daromad
Misol: narx 2 582 000 so‘m; kuniga 5 ta mashina × 50 000 so‘m diagnostika haqi = 250 000 so‘m → T ≈ 11 ish kuni. (Diagnostika haqi va mashinalar soni misol uchun olingan.)
foyda: Nosozlikni taxmin bilan emas, kod bo‘yicha topadi: keraksiz ehtiyot qism almashtirilmaydi.
uz: Toshkentdagi automaster.uz (Launch vakili) saytida sotuvda bor: 2 582 000 so‘m, bo‘lib to‘lash mumkin.

videolar.nomi: Launch X431 diagnostika skaneri — o‘zbek tilida
videolar.izoh: Toshkentdagi sotuvchining o‘zi Launch skanerini ko‘rsatadi.

videolar.nomi: Cobalt diagnostikasi skaner bilan — o‘zbek tilida
videolar.izoh: Chevrolet Cobalt misolida skanerni ulash va xatolarni o‘qish.
Creader seriyasidagi qo‘l skanerini OBD-II uyasiga ulash va kodlarni o‘qish.

nima: 4-inch touchscreen, Android system, Russian-language interface
Works with every make built since 1996 that has a 16-pin OBD-II socket
Reads and clears fault codes; connects to the car by cable
en.qayerda: In car service shops in Tashkent and the regions, and with car owners: when the Check Engine light comes on, it shows the cause within minutes.
ustun: Many times cheaper than the Autel MaxiSys Ultra, and it fits in a pocket
The Ultra checks every electronic unit and the EV battery — the CRE916 works with one system
mat: Payback period: T = Price ÷ daily income
Example: price 2,582,000 soums; 5 cars a day × 50,000 soums per diagnosis = 250,000 soums → T ≈ 11 working days. (The fee and number of cars are example values.)
en.foyda: Finds the fault by code, not by guesswork: no parts are replaced unnecessarily.
en.uz: On sale at automaster.uz in Tashkent (Launch’s representative): 2,582,000 soums, instalments available.
videolar: Launch X431 diagnostic scanner — in Uzbek
The Tashkent seller demonstrates a Launch scanner.
Diagnosing a Cobalt with a scanner — in Uzbek
Connecting the scanner and reading faults on a Chevrolet Cobalt.
Working with a Launch Creader scanner
Plugging a Creader handheld scanner into the OBD-II socket and reading codes.

nima: Sun’iy intellekt yordamchisi nosozlik sababini taklif qiladi
Topology 3.0: barcha elektron bloklar bitta xaritada, nosoz blok rangi bilan ajraladi
Elektromobil (EV) yuqori voltli batareyasini tekshirish rejimi
qayerda: Avtoservisda mashinaning OBD-II uyasiga simsiz adapter ulanadi; usta planshetda barcha bloklarni bir necha soniyada skanerlaydi va xato kodlarini o‘qiydi.
mat: Batareya salomatligi: SOH = (hozirgi sig‘im ÷ pasport sig‘imi) × 100%
Misol: 54 kVt·soat ÷ 60 kVt·soat × 100% = 90%. 80% dan pastda batareya almashtirishga yaqin hisoblanadi.
ustun: Oldingi Ultra modelidagi Topology 2.0 o‘rniga Topology 3.0
Oddiy OBD-skaner faqat dvigatel xatolarini o‘qiydi, bu esa barcha bloklarni va EV batareyasini tekshiradi
foyda: Nosozlik sababini qidirishga ketadigan vaqt qisqaradi: usta bir kunda ko‘proq mashina qabul qiladi.
uz: Autel’ning O‘zbekistondagi rasmiy vakili topilmadi — shu sababli ro‘yxatda birinchi bo‘lib Toshkentda sotiladigan Launch CRE916 turibdi.

sf.izoh: OBD-II uyasiga ulanadigan diagnostika adapteri — Autel planshetining o‘zi emas, shu tizimning mashinaga ulanadigan qismi.

nima: An AI assistant suggests the likely cause of a fault
Topology 3.0: all electronic units on one map, the faulty one highlighted by colour
A test mode for the high-voltage battery of electric vehicles
en.qayerda: In a car service shop a wireless adapter plugs into the car’s OBD-II socket; the technician scans every unit on the tablet in seconds and reads the fault codes.
ustun: Topology 3.0 replaces the Topology 2.0 of the previous Ultra
A basic OBD scanner reads only engine faults; this one checks every unit and the EV battery
mat: Battery state of health: SOH = (current capacity ÷ rated capacity) × 100%
Example: 54 kWh ÷ 60 kWh × 100% = 90%. Below 80% a battery is considered close to replacement.
en.foyda: Less time is spent hunting for the cause: a technician can take in more cars per day.
en.uz: No official Autel representative was found in Uzbekistan — so the Launch CRE916, which is sold in Tashkent, comes first in this list.
en.sf: An adapter that plugs into the OBD-II socket — not the Autel tablet itself, but the part of the system that connects to the car.

nima: Weld Wizard yordamchisi: material va qalinlik kiritilsa, rejimni o‘zi sozlaydi
Tashqi sim uzatgich bilan bitta apparatda ikkita g‘altak va ikkita gorelka
Impulsli payvandlash, SynchroPulse va tarmoqqa ulanish imkoniyati
qayerda: Metall konstruksiya sexlari va ta’mirlash ustaxonalarida po‘lat, zanglamas po‘lat va alyuminiy detallarni yarim avtomat payvandlashda.
mat: Issiqlik kiritish: Q = η · U · I · 60 ÷ (v · 1000), kJ/mm
Misol: U = 22,4 V, I = 185 A, v = 400 mm/min, η = 0,8 → Q ≈ 0,50 kJ/mm. Q katta bo‘lsa metall ko‘proq qiziydi va deformatsiya ortadi.
ustun: Oddiy invertorda tok va kuchlanish qo‘lda tanlanadi; bu yerda yordamchi dastur rejimni o‘zi taklif qiladi
Ikki g‘altak bilan materialni almashtirish uchun qayta sozlash shart emas
foyda: Brak choklar va qayta payvandlash kamayadi; yangi payvandchi tezroq mustaqil ishlay boshlaydi.
uz: Fronius e’loni prom.uz da topilmadi. Shu sinfdagi yarim avtomatlar Toshkentda sotiladi: Jasic MIG 350 — 14 522 868 so‘m, ESAB Caddy MIG C200i — 19 436 438 so‘mdan.

sf.izoh: Gaz balloni va aravachali MIG/MAG payvandlash apparati — Fronius Fortis emas, shu sinfdagi apparat.

videolar.izoh: Uchma-uch, burchakli, tavr va ustma-ust birikmalar; chokning fazodagi holatlari: pastki, vertikal, gorizontal, shift.
Yoyni yoqish va ushlab turish: har qanday chokning boshlanishi. Yangi boshlovchilar uchun.
Elektrod burchagi, yoy uzunligi va harakat tezligi chok shaklini belgilaydi. Uchma-uch chok shu holatda o‘rganiladi.
Ikki detal 90° ostida ulanadi. Elektrod burchak bissektrisasi bo‘ylab, ikkala devorni teng eritib yuritiladi.
Bir list ikkinchisining ustiga qo‘yiladi; chok yuqori list qirrasi bo‘ylab tushadi. Yupqa metallda ko‘p ishlatiladi.
Erigan metall pastga oqmasligi uchun pastdan yuqoriga, qisqa yoy bilan payvandlanadi.
Eng qiyin holat: vanna tepada turadi. Tok kamaytiriladi, yoy juda qisqa ushlanadi.
Sim uzluksiz uzatiladi, vanna himoya gazi ostida. Fronius Fortis kabi apparatlar shu usulda ishlaydi.
Erimaydigan volfram elektrod va argon gazi: zanglamas po‘lat va alyuminiyda eng toza chok.
Metall tomchisi elektroddan vannaga qanday o‘tishi juda sekinlashtirilgan tasvirda ko‘rinadi.

nima: Weld Wizard: enter the material and thickness and it sets the parameters itself
With an external wire feeder, one machine runs two spools and two torches
Pulse welding, SynchroPulse and network connectivity
en.qayerda: In steel fabrication and repair workshops, for semi-automatic welding of steel, stainless steel and aluminium parts.
ustun: On an ordinary inverter current and voltage are chosen by hand; here the assistant proposes the settings
With two spools there is no retooling when the material changes
mat: Heat input: Q = η · U · I · 60 ÷ (v · 1000), kJ/mm
Example: U = 22.4 V, I = 185 A, v = 400 mm/min, η = 0.8 → Q ≈ 0.50 kJ/mm. A higher Q heats the metal more and increases distortion.
en.foyda: Fewer rejected welds and less rework; a new welder becomes independent sooner.
en.uz: No Fronius listing was found on prom.uz. Semi-automatic machines of the same class are sold in Tashkent: Jasic MIG 350 — 14,522,868 soums, ESAB Caddy MIG C200i — from 19,436,438 soums.
en.sf: A MIG/MAG welding machine with a gas cylinder and trolley — not the Fronius Fortis, but a machine of the same class.
videolar: Butt, corner, T and lap joints; welding positions: flat, vertical, horizontal, overhead.
Striking and holding the arc: the start of every weld. For beginners.
Electrode angle, arc length and travel speed decide the bead shape. The butt weld is learned in this position.
Two parts meet at 90°. The electrode follows the bisector of the angle, melting both walls equally.
One sheet lies on the other; the bead runs along the edge of the top sheet. Common on thin metal.
Welded upwards with a short arc so the molten metal does not run down.
The hardest position: the weld pool hangs above. Current is reduced and the arc kept very short.
Wire feeds continuously and the pool is shielded by gas. Machines like the Fronius Fortis work this way.
A non-consumable tungsten electrode and argon gas: the cleanest weld on stainless steel and aluminium.
The welding arc in slow motion
Shows how a drop of metal passes from the electrode into the pool.

nima: Yangi avlod: issiqlik tasviri sifati oshirilgan
QR-kod orqali har bir jihozni belgilash va tekshiruv profillari
Tasvirlarni simsiz uzatish va standart hisobot
qayerda: Elektr shchitlari, transformator va dvigatellarni tok ostida, tegmasdan tekshirishda: bo‘shashgan kontakt ekranda qizg‘ish «issiq nuqta» bo‘lib ko‘rinadi.
mat: Kontaktda ajraladigan issiqlik: P = I² · R
Misol: I = 40 A, bo‘shashgan kontakt qarshiligi R = 0,05 Ω → P = 40² · 0,05 = 80 Vt. Shu 80 Vt kontaktni qizdiradi — teplovizor uni «issiq nuqta» qilib ko‘rsatadi.
ustun: Multimetr faqat bitta nuqtani, teplovizor butun shchitni bir qarashda tekshiradi
Tok ostida, tegmasdan va xavfsiz masofadan o‘lchaydi
foyda: Kontakt kuyishidan oldin topiladi: avariya va ishlab chiqarish to‘xtashining oldi olinadi.
uz: Fluke teplovizorlari Toshkentda sotiladi: prom.uz va glotr.uz saytlarida TiS va Ti seriyalari e’lon qilingan (masalan, Fluke Ti450 — 107 000 000 so‘m). Aynan TiS75 PRO e’loni topilmadi.

sf.izoh: FLIR E5 teplovizori — Fluke emas, xuddi shu turdagi qo‘l teplovizori.

videolar.izoh: Shchitdagi qizigan kontaktni teplovizor bilan topish misoli.
Tok ostidagi jihozlarni masofadan ko‘zdan kechirish.

nima: New generation with improved thermal image quality
QR-code tagging of each asset and inspection profiles
Wireless image transfer and standardised reports
en.qayerda: For inspecting switchboards, transformers and motors while live and without contact: a loose connection shows on screen as a reddish hot spot.
ustun: A multimeter checks one point; a thermal imager checks the whole board at a glance
Measures live equipment without contact, from a safe distance
mat: Heat released at a contact: P = I² · R
Example: I = 40 A, resistance of a loose contact R = 0.05 Ω → P = 40² · 0.05 = 80 W. Those 80 W heat the contact — the imager shows it as a hot spot.
en.foyda: The contact is found before it burns out: breakdowns and production stoppages are prevented.
en.uz: Fluke thermal imagers are sold in Tashkent: TiS and Ti series are listed on prom.uz and glotr.uz (for example, the Fluke Ti450 at 107,000,000 soums). No listing for the TiS75 PRO itself was found.
en.sf: A FLIR E5 thermal imager — not a Fluke, but the same type of handheld imager.
videolar: A thermal imager helping an electrician
An example of finding an overheated contact in a switchboard.
Inspecting switchboards at a transformer substation
Examining live equipment from a distance.

nima: Bir ignali to‘g‘ri (mokili) chok — tikuv sexining asosiy mashinasi
Toshkentda yangi holda, sotuvchi e’loniga ko‘ra 3 yil kafolat va servis bilan sotiladi
JACK Uzbekistan kanali bozorda soxta F5 lar uchrashidan ogohlantirgan — rasmiy sotuvchidan olish kerak
qayerda: O‘zbekistondagi tikuv sexlari va fabrikalarida: ko‘ylak, shim, ish kiyimi va uy to‘qimachiligi choklarining asosiy qismi shu turdagi mashinada tikiladi.
ustun: JUKI DX-01 ga nisbatan ancha arzon, ehtiyot qismi va ustasi Toshkentning o‘zida bor
DX-01 da sozlamalar raqamli va xotirada saqlanadi — F5 da sozlash ko‘proq chevarning tajribasiga bog‘liq
mat: O‘zini oqlash muddati: T = Narx ÷ kunlik sof daromad
Misol: narx 3 025 597 so‘m; kuniga 40 ta buyum × 2 000 so‘m tikish haqi = 80 000 so‘m → T ≈ 38 ish kuni. (Tikish haqi va buyum soni misol uchun olingan.)
foyda: Kichik sex uchun eng arzon kirish: bitta mashina bir yarim-ikki oyda o‘zini oqlashi mumkin.
uz: prom.uz da «Jack F5» sanoat to‘g‘ri chok mashinasi 3 025 597 so‘mdan (Grand Tech), F5/310 modellari 3 751 740 so‘mdan (Sew Master Royal) e’lon qilingan; Toshkentga yetkazib beriladi.

sf.izoh: Stolli sanoat tikuv mashinasi — umumiy ko‘rinishi; JUKI DX-01 ning aniq nusxasi emas.

videolar.izoh: Igna ipi va moki ipi mato ichida chirmashadi. Ikki tomoni bir xil ko‘rinadi, so‘kilmaydi, lekin cho‘zilmaydi. Eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan chok.
Igna ipi pastda ilmoqchi ipi bilan zanjir hosil qiladi. Cho‘ziluvchan va tez tikiladi; uchidan tortilsa so‘kiladi. Jinsi shimlarning yon choklari.
Bitta igna va ikkita ilmoqchi, uch ip. Mato qirg‘og‘ini kesib, titilmasligi uchun o‘rab tikadi.
Uch igna va beshta ip. Trikotaj buyumlarda yassi, cho‘ziluvchan chok: futbolka etagi, sport kiyimi.
Igna har qaviqda o‘ngga-chapga suriladi. Cho‘ziluvchan matolar, applikatsiya va qirg‘oqni mahkamlash uchun.
videolar.manba: KNiTism kanali, sanoat zigzag mashinasi (rus tilida)

videolar.izoh: Egri igna matoning faqat yarim qalinligini ilib o‘tadi — chok o‘ng tomonda ko‘rinmaydi. Shim va yubka etagini bukish.
videolar.manba: Praktyk kanali, etak bukish mashinasi (rus tilida)

videolar.izoh: Mashina teshik atrofini zich zigzag bilan o‘rab tikadi va o‘rtasini kesadi.

nima: Single-needle straight lockstitch — the main machine of any sewing workshop
Sold new in Tashkent with, according to the seller’s listing, a 3-year warranty and service
The JACK Uzbekistan channel has warned that fake F5 machines appear on the market — buy from an official seller
en.qayerda: In sewing workshops and factories across Uzbekistan: most seams of shirts, trousers, workwear and home textiles are sewn on this type of machine.
ustun: Far cheaper than the JUKI DX-01, with spare parts and mechanics available in Tashkent itself
On the DX-01 settings are digital and stored in memory — on the F5 setup depends more on the operator’s experience
mat: Payback period: T = Price ÷ daily net income
Example: price 3,025,597 soums; 40 garments a day × 2,000 soums sewing fee = 80,000 soums → T ≈ 38 working days. (The fee and number of garments are example values.)
en.foyda: The cheapest way into the trade for a small workshop: one machine can pay for itself in a month and a half to two months.
en.uz: On prom.uz the Jack F5 industrial lockstitch machine is listed from 3,025,597 soums (Grand Tech) and F5/310 models from 3,751,740 soums (Sew Master Royal); delivered to Tashkent.
en.sf: An industrial sewing machine with its table — a general view, not an exact copy of this model.
videolar: The needle thread and bobbin thread interlock inside the fabric. Looks the same on both sides and does not unravel, but does not stretch. The most widely used stitch.
The needle thread forms a chain with the looper thread underneath. Stretchy and fast to sew; unravels if pulled from the end. Side seams of jeans.
One needle and two loopers, three threads. Trims the fabric edge and wraps it so it does not fray.
Three needles and five threads. A flat, stretchy seam on knitwear: T-shirt hems, sportswear.
The needle shifts left and right with each stitch. For stretch fabrics, appliqué and securing edges.
KNiTism channel, industrial zigzag machine (in Russian)
A curved needle catches only half the thickness of the fabric — the seam is invisible on the right side. Hemming trousers and skirts.
The machine surrounds the hole with dense zigzag stitching and cuts the centre.

nima: Mato surish, tepki bosimi va ip tarangligi raqam bilan o‘rnatiladi va xotirada saqlanadi
Egri choklar va «posadka» (o‘tqazish) nisbati avtomatik boshqariladi
Sozlamalar tarmoq orqali boshqa mashinalarga ko‘chiriladi
qayerda: Tikuv fabrikalarida yeng o‘tqazish kabi murakkab egri choklarda: tajribali chevarning sozlamasi saqlanadi va har qanday operator uni takrorlaydi.
mat: Chok tezligi: v = n · l (n — daqiqadagi qaviqlar soni, l — qaviq uzunligi)
Misol: n = 4000 qaviq/min, l = 3 mm → v = 12 m/min. 1,5 metrli chok 7,5 soniyada tikiladi.
ustun: Mexanik mashinada taranglik va bosim vint bilan «ko‘z chamasi» sozlanadi; bu yerda raqam bilan va xotiradan
Sozlama bir mashinadan boshqasiga tarmoq orqali ko‘chadi
foyda: Model almashganda qayta sozlash vaqti qisqaradi, chok sifati operatorga kam bog‘liq bo‘ladi.
uz: JUKI’ning O‘zbekistondagi rasmiy dileri qidiruvda topilmadi — shu sababli ro‘yxatda birinchi bo‘lib O‘zbekistonda sotiladigan Jack F5 turibdi.

sf.izoh: Stolli sanoat tikuv mashinasi — umumiy ko‘rinishi; JUKI DX-01 ning aniq nusxasi emas.

nima: Fabric feed, presser-foot pressure and thread tension are set as numbers and stored in memory
Curved seams and easing ratios are controlled automatically
Settings are copied to other machines over the network
en.qayerda: In garment factories, on complex curved seams such as setting a sleeve: an experienced operator’s settings are saved and any operator can repeat them.
ustun: On a mechanical machine tension and pressure are set by screw and by eye; here by number and from memory
Settings move from one machine to another over the network
mat: Sewing speed: v = n · l (n — stitches per minute, l — stitch length)
Example: n = 4000 stitches/min, l = 3 mm → v = 12 m/min. A 1.5-metre seam is sewn in 7.5 seconds.
en.foyda: Less time is lost on re-setting when the model changes, and seam quality depends less on the operator.
en.uz: No official JUKI dealer was found in Uzbekistan — so the Jack F5, which is sold in Uzbekistan, comes first in this list.
en.sf: An industrial sewing machine with its table — a general view, not an exact copy of the JUKI DX-01.

nima: Ko‘p qavatli mato to‘shamasini dastur bo‘yicha pichoq bilan bichadi
Bichish kallagi mato turiga moslashadi
2026-yil sentabrda Lectra loyihalash uchun Apogy sun’iy intellekt platformasini chiqardi: 2D andaza va 3D namuna bitta raqamli egizakda
qayerda: Tikuv korxonasining bichish sexida: konstruktor kompyuterda andazalarni joylashtiradi, mashina to‘shamani millimetr aniqligida kesadi.
mat: Joylashtirish samaradorligi: E = (andazalar yuzi ÷ mato yuzi) × 100%
Misol: to‘shama 1,5 m × 6 m = 9 m², andazalar yuzi 7,74 m² → E = 86%. Samaradorlik 1% oshsa, 50 qavatli to‘shamada 4,5 m² mato tejaladi.
ustun: Qo‘lda bichishda aniqlik bichuvchiga bog‘liq; avtomat har qavatni bir xil kesadi
Dastur andazalarni matoga eng tejamli joylashtiradi
foyda: Mato kiyim tannarxining eng katta qismi — chiqindining har foizi to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri foyda.
uz: Lectra e’loni topilmadi. Toshkentda Tristar Technologies firmasi Serkon avtomatik bichish komplekslarini 36 307 170 so‘mdan e’lon qilgan; e’lonlarda «sotuvda yo‘q» deb belgilangan.

sf.izoh: Mato o‘lchash va bichish mashinasi — Lectra Vector emas, shu ishni bajaradigan boshqa turdagi jihoz.

videolar.izoh: Ishlab chiqaruvchining o‘z videosi: ko‘p qavatli to‘shamani bichish.
Bichish kompleksi sexda ishlamoqda.

nima: Cuts a multi-ply lay of fabric with a knife, following a program
The cutting head adapts to the type of fabric
In September 2026 Lectra released Apogy, an AI platform for product development: 2D patterns and 3D samples in one digital twin
en.qayerda: In the cutting room of a garment factory: the pattern maker arranges the patterns on a computer and the machine cuts the lay to the millimetre.
ustun: With hand cutting, accuracy depends on the cutter; the machine cuts every ply identically
Software arranges the patterns on the fabric in the most economical way
mat: Marker efficiency: E = (area of patterns ÷ area of fabric) × 100%
Example: a lay of 1.5 m × 6 m = 9 m², pattern area 7.74 m² → E = 86%. Each extra 1% of efficiency saves 4.5 m² of fabric on a 50-ply lay.
en.foyda: Fabric is the largest part of a garment’s cost — every percent of waste saved is direct profit.
en.uz: No Lectra listing was found. In Tashkent, Tristar Technologies lists Serkon automatic cutting systems from 36,307,170 soums; the listings are marked “out of stock”.
en.sf: A fabric measuring and cutting machine — not the Lectra Vector, but a different type of machine doing the same job.
videolar: The manufacturer’s own video: cutting a multi-ply lay.
The cutting system running on the shop floor.

nima: Eng yangi avlod lazer generatori
7 dyuymli sensorli ekran va sodda dastur
Faol havo sovutish tizimi, ixcham korpus
qayerda: Zargarlik ustaxonasida zanjir va tosh uyachalarini ta’mirlashda: lazer nuqtasi juda kichik, yonidagi tosh qizimaydi.
mat: Impuls quvvati: P = E ÷ t
Misol: E = 2,4 J, t = 3 ms = 0,003 s → P = 800 Vt. Energiya kichik, lekin juda qisqa vaqtda berilgani uchun metall faqat bir nuqtada eriydi.
ustun: Gaz gorelkasi butun buyumni qizdiradi; lazer faqat nuqtani — yonidagi tosh va emal shikastlanmaydi
Kavsharsiz, buyumning o‘z metalli bilan payvandlaydi
foyda: Toshni chiqarmasdan ta’mirlash mumkin: ish tezlashadi, buyumni buzish xavfi kamayadi.
uz: Zargarlik uchun maxsus lazer payvandlagich e’loni topilmadi. Metall uchun qo‘l lazer payvandlash apparatlari sotiladi: masalan, HUGONG HGLW-1500E — 77 455 296 so‘m.

videolar.izoh: Apparatni sozlash va buyumni payvandlash.
Kichik buyumda nuqtali payvand.

nima: Latest-generation laser source
7-inch touchscreen and simple software
Active air cooling in a compact body
en.qayerda: In a jewellery workshop, for repairing chains and stone settings: the laser spot is so small that the stone next to it does not heat up.
ustun: A gas torch heats the whole piece; the laser heats only a point — nearby stones and enamel are not damaged
Welds with the piece’s own metal, without solder
mat: Pulse power: P = E ÷ t
Example: E = 2.4 J, t = 3 ms = 0.003 s → P = 800 W. The energy is small, but delivered so quickly that the metal melts at a single point.
en.foyda: Repairs can be made without removing the stone: the work is faster and the risk of damaging the piece is lower.
en.uz: No listing for a dedicated jewellery laser welder was found. Handheld laser welders for metal are sold: for example, the HUGONG HGLW-1500E at 77,455,296 soums.
videolar: Jewellery laser welding: a work example
Setting up the machine and welding a piece.
Repairing an earring with a laser
Spot welding on a small piece.

nima: Oldingi modeldan 30% kichik va 20% yengil
Nasadkalardagi RFID datchik havo oqimi va haroratni o‘zi tanlaydi
Havo harorati soniyasiga 20 martadan ko‘p o‘lchanadi — soch kuymaydi
qayerda: Sartaroshxonada soch quritish va turmaklashda; faqat professional sartaroshlarga sotiladi.
mat: Sarflangan energiya: E = P · t
Misol: quvvati 1,6 kVt bo‘lgan fen 10 daqiqa ishlasa: E = 1,6 · (10 ÷ 60) ≈ 0,27 kVt·soat. Kuniga 20 mijoz bo‘lsa — 5,3 kVt·soat. (Quvvat misol uchun olingan.)
ustun: Oldingi Supersonic’dan 30% kichik va 20% yengil — sartarosh bilagi kam charchaydi
Nasadka almashtirilganda harorat va oqim avtomatik moslashadi
foyda: Soch tez quriydi va kuymaydi; sartarosh kun davomida kamroq charchaydi.
uz: prom.uz da Dyson Supersonic feni 7 712 500 so‘mdan e’lon qilingan (Buy me, Toshkent), lekin e’londa «sotuvda yo‘q» deb belgilangan. Professional «r» modelining e’loni topilmadi.

sf.izoh: Dyson Supersonic Professional — «r» modelidan oldingi avlod.

videolar.izoh: Fen va dumaloq cho‘tka bilan sochni quritib turmaklash texnikasi.

nima: 30% smaller and 20% lighter than the previous model
An RFID sensor in each attachment sets the airflow and temperature automatically
Air temperature is measured more than 20 times a second — the hair is not burned
en.qayerda: In hair salons for drying and styling; sold only to professional stylists.
ustun: 30% smaller and 20% lighter than the earlier Supersonic — less strain on the stylist’s wrist
Temperature and airflow adjust automatically when the attachment is changed
mat: Energy used: E = P · t
Example: a 1.6 kW dryer running for 10 minutes: E = 1.6 · (10 ÷ 60) ≈ 0.27 kWh. With 20 clients a day — 5.3 kWh. (The power rating is an example value.)
en.foyda: Hair dries quickly without burning; the stylist is less tired over the day.
en.uz: On prom.uz a Dyson Supersonic dryer is listed from 7,712,500 soums (Buy me, Tashkent), but marked “out of stock”. No listing for the professional “r” model was found.
en.sf: Dyson Supersonic Professional — the generation before the “r” model.
videolar: Drying and styling hair with a dryer and a round brush.

nima: To‘rtta «aqlli yordamchi» pishirish jarayonini o‘zi boshqaradi
Bug‘ va issiq havoni birga ishlatadi: bir pechda qovurish, dimlash, pishirish
ConnectedCooking orqali tarmoqdan kuzatish
qayerda: Restoran va oshxona sexlarida: bir vaqtda bir necha tovoqda go‘sht, non va sabzavot pishiriladi, sifat har safar bir xil chiqadi.
mat: Mahsulotni isitish uchun issiqlik: Q = c · m · ΔT
Misol: m = 10 kg, c ≈ 3,5 kJ/(kg·°C), ΔT = 160 °C → Q = 5600 kJ ≈ 1,56 kVt·soat. Pech sarfini shu son bilan solishtirib, foydali ish koeffitsiyentini baholash mumkin.
ustun: Oddiy duxovkada faqat issiq havo; bu yerda bug‘ va havo birga — go‘sht qurib qolmaydi
Bir pech plita, duxovka va bug‘ qozonining ishini bajaradi
foyda: Bir vaqtda 6–10 tovoq pishadi, mahsulot vazni kam yo‘qoladi, oshpaz pech oldida turishi shart emas.
uz: Toshkentda sotuvda bor: RATIONAL iCombi Pro 6-1/1 — 174 982 000 so‘m (Delicom).

videolar.izoh: Bug‘ va issiq havoning birga ishlash tamoyili.
Pechning ekrani, rejimlari va tovoqlarni joylash.

nima: Four intelligent assistants control the cooking process themselves
Uses steam and hot air together: roasting, stewing and baking in one oven
Remote monitoring through ConnectedCooking
en.qayerda: In restaurants and production kitchens: meat, bread and vegetables cook on several trays at once, with the same quality every time.
ustun: An ordinary oven uses hot air only; here steam and air work together — meat does not dry out
One oven does the work of a stove, an oven and a steamer
mat: Heat needed to warm the food: Q = c · m · ΔT
Example: m = 10 kg, c ≈ 3.5 kJ/(kg·°C), ΔT = 160 °C → Q = 5600 kJ ≈ 1.56 kWh. Comparing the oven’s consumption with this figure gives an estimate of its efficiency.
en.foyda: 6–10 trays cook at once, the food loses less weight, and the chef need not stand by the oven.
en.uz: On sale in Tashkent: RATIONAL iCombi Pro 6-1/1 — 174,982,000 soums (Delicom).
videolar: The principle of steam and hot air working together.
The oven’s screen, modes and tray loading.

nima: Ikkita elektr motor va to‘liq yuritma
To‘liq elektr rejimda chiqindisiz va shovqinsiz ishlaydi
Barcha funksiyalar kabinadagi 17 dyuymli ekrandan boshqariladi
qayerda: Shahar o‘t o‘chirish qismlarida (Los-Anjeles, Viktoriya va boshqa shaharlar): tor ko‘chalarda chaqqon, nasos ishlaganda ekipaj bir-birini eshitadi.
mat: Sisternadagi suv yetadigan vaqt: t = V ÷ q
Misol: V = 2000 l, bitta stvol sarfi q = 7,4 l/s → t ≈ 270 s = 4,5 daqiqa. Ikki stvol ishlasa — ikki baravar kam. (Sisterna hajmi misol uchun olingan.)
ustun: Dizel mashinaga nisbatan chiqindi gaz va shovqin yo‘q — ekipaj nasos yonida bir-birini eshitadi
Past pol va to‘liq yuritma: tor ko‘chalarda chaqqon
foyda: Yoqilg‘i sarfi va ekipaj sog‘lig‘iga zarar kamayadi.
uz: O‘zbekistonda Rosenbauer RTX borligi haqida ma’lumot topilmadi. FVVga 2022-yilda Janubiy Koreya o‘t o‘chirish va tibbiy texnika bergan; mamlakatda MAN shassisidagi o‘t o‘chirish avtosisternalari sotiladi.

sf.izoh: Rosenbauer Panther 6×6 — aeroport o‘t o‘chirish mashinasi; shahar uchun RTX modeli emas.

videolar.nomi: Rosenbauer RT: bir yillik ish tajribasi
videolar.izoh: Ishlab chiqaruvchining o‘z videosi: elektr mashina aeroport o‘t o‘chirish xizmatida.

videolar.nomi: Rosenbauer RT/RTX: tashqi va ichki ko‘rinish
videolar.izoh: Mashinaning kabinasi, bo‘linmalari va boshqaruvi.
Avtosisterna nasosini ishga tushirish tartibi — O‘zbekistondagi mashinalarda ham shu turdagi nasos.

nima: Two electric motors and all-wheel drive
Runs with zero emissions and almost no noise in full-electric mode
Every function is controlled from a 17-inch display in the cab
en.qayerda: In city fire brigades (Los Angeles, Victoria and other cities): agile in narrow streets, and the crew can hear each other while the pump is running.
ustun: No exhaust fumes or noise compared with a diesel engine — the crew can hear each other beside the pump
Low floor and all-wheel drive: agile in narrow streets
mat: How long the water tank lasts: t = V ÷ q
Example: V = 2000 l, one nozzle uses q = 7.4 l/s → t ≈ 270 s = 4.5 minutes. With two nozzles, half that. (The tank volume is an example value.)
en.foyda: Lower fuel costs and less harm to the crew’s health.
en.uz: No information was found about a Rosenbauer RTX in Uzbekistan. In 2022 South Korea donated firefighting and medical vehicles to the Ministry of Emergency Situations; fire tankers on MAN chassis are sold in the country.
en.sf: A Rosenbauer Panther 6×6 — an airport fire engine, not the RTX model for cities.
videolar: Rosenbauer RT: one year in service
The manufacturer’s own video: the electric engine in an airport fire service.
How to start a tanker’s pump — fire engines in Uzbekistan carry the same type of pump.

nima: Ikkita soplo: biri modelni, ikkinchisi tayanchni boshqa materialdan bosadi
Isitiladigan kamera — muhandislik plastiklari uchun
31 ta datchik chop sifatini kuzatadi
qayerda: Dizayn studiyalari va muhandislik bo‘limlarida: kompyuterda chizilgan 3D model bir necha soatda qo‘lga ushlanadigan detalga aylanadi.
mat: Hajmiy unumdorlik: Q = w · h · v; chop vaqti t ≈ V ÷ Q
Misol: chiziq eni w = 0,42 mm, qatlam h = 0,2 mm, tezlik v = 200 mm/s → Q = 16,8 mm³/s. Hajmi 50 sm³ detal: t ≈ 50 000 ÷ 16,8 ≈ 50 daqiqa.
ustun: Bir soploli printerda tayanch ham shu plastikdan bosiladi va qiyin ajraladi; ikki soploda tayanch boshqa, oson ajraladigan materialdan
Isitiladigan kamera muhandislik plastiklarida qiyshayishni kamaytiradi
foyda: Maket va ehtiyot qism buyurtma kutmasdan, shu kunning o‘zida tayyor bo‘ladi.
uz: Toshkentda Nova Plus firmasi Bambu Lab printerlarini buyurtma asosida keltiradi: e’lonlarda 6 051 195 so‘mdan. Aynan X2D modeli alohida ko‘rsatilmagan.

sf.izoh: Bambu Lab A1 — shu ishlab chiqaruvchining ochiq ramkali modeli; X2D emas.

videolar.izoh: Plastik ipni eritib, qatlam-qatlam bosish tamoyili.
X2D ning oldingi X1C modelidan farqlari.

nima: Two nozzles: one prints the model, the other prints supports in a different material
A heated chamber for engineering plastics
31 sensors monitor print quality
en.qayerda: In design studios and engineering departments: a 3D model drawn on a computer becomes a part you can hold within a few hours.
ustun: On a single-nozzle printer supports are printed in the same plastic and are hard to remove; with two nozzles they are a different, easily removed material
The heated chamber reduces warping of engineering plastics
mat: Volumetric flow: Q = w · h · v; print time t ≈ V ÷ Q
Example: line width w = 0.42 mm, layer h = 0.2 mm, speed v = 200 mm/s → Q = 16.8 mm³/s. A 50 cm³ part: t ≈ 50,000 ÷ 16.8 ≈ 50 minutes.
en.foyda: A mock-up or spare part is ready the same day instead of waiting for an order.
en.uz: In Tashkent, Nova Plus supplies Bambu Lab printers to order: listed from 6,051,195 soums. The X2D model is not named separately.
en.sf: A Bambu Lab A1 — an open-frame model from the same maker; not the X2D.
videolar: The principle of melting plastic filament and printing layer by layer.
Bambu Lab X2D: what is new
How the X2D differs from the earlier X1C.

nima: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) standarti
WPA3 shifrlash majburiy
Ixcham korpus, bulut yoki joyida boshqarish
qayerda: Ofis, maktab va shifoxonalarda shiftga o‘rnatiladi va o‘nlab qurilmalarni bir vaqtda tez internet bilan ta’minlaydi.
mat: Kanal sig‘imi (Shennon formulasi): C = B · log₂(1 + S/N)
Misol: B = 320 MGs, S/N = 1000 (30 dB) → C = 320 · log₂(1001) ≈ 3,19 Gbit/s. Kanal eni ikki baravar oshsa, tezlik chegarasi ham ikki baravar oshadi.
ustun: Wi-Fi 6 da kanal eni 160 MGs gacha, Wi-Fi 7 da 320 MGs gacha
Qurilma bir vaqtda bir necha diapazonda ulanadi — uzilish kamayadi
foyda: Bir xonadagi o‘nlab qurilma bir-biriga xalaqit bermay ishlaydi.
uz: Toshkentda Cisco Catalyst 9115AX kirish nuqtasi (Wi-Fi 6) 9 200 000 so‘mdan sotiladi (Universal Tekhno Systems). Wi-Fi 7 li Cisco modeli e’loni topilmadi.

sf.izoh: Cisco Catalyst 9130 kirish nuqtasi (Wi-Fi 6) — CW9171 dan oldingi avlod.

videolar.nomi: Wi-Fi kirish nuqtasi nima uchun kerak
videolar.izoh: Router va kirish nuqtasining farqi, tarmoqni kengaytirish.
320 MGs kanal va bir necha diapazonda bir vaqtda ishlash tushuntiriladi.

nima: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) standard
WPA3 encryption is mandatory
Compact body, managed from the cloud or on site
en.qayerda: Mounted on the ceiling in offices, schools and hospitals, giving dozens of devices fast internet at once.
ustun: Wi-Fi 6 channels are up to 160 MHz wide; Wi-Fi 7 channels up to 320 MHz
A device connects on several bands at once — fewer dropouts
mat: Channel capacity (Shannon’s formula): C = B · log₂(1 + S/N)
Example: B = 320 MHz, S/N = 1000 (30 dB) → C = 320 · log₂(1001) ≈ 3.19 Gbit/s. Doubling the channel width doubles the speed limit.
en.foyda: Dozens of devices in one room work without interfering with each other.
en.uz: In Tashkent the Cisco Catalyst 9115AX access point (Wi-Fi 6) is sold from 9,200,000 soums (Universal Tekhno Systems). No listing for a Cisco Wi-Fi 7 model was found.
en.sf: A Cisco Catalyst 9130 access point (Wi-Fi 6) — the generation before the CW9171.
videolar: Why a Wi-Fi access point is needed
The difference between a router and an access point; extending a network.
Explains the 320 MHz channel and working on several bands at once.

nima: Bluetooth orqali o‘lchov natijasi telefon yoki planshetga real vaqtda boradi
Simlar yo‘q — tajriba stoli ozoda
SPARKvue dasturi grafikni o‘zi chizadi
qayerda: Zamonaviy fizika va kimyo laboratoriyalarida: simobli termometr o‘rniga datchik eritmaga tushiriladi, isish grafigi ekranda chiziladi.
mat: Isish qonuni: T(t) = T∞ − (T∞ − T₀) · e^(−kt)
Misol: T₀ = 22 °C, T∞ = 100 °C, k = 0,01 1/s → 60 soniyadan keyin T ≈ 57,2 °C. Datchik chizgan grafik aynan shu eksponenta.
ustun: Simobli termometr bitta sonni ko‘rsatadi; datchik butun jarayonni grafik qilib yozadi
Simsiz — stolda sim va shtativ chigalligi yo‘q
foyda: O‘quvchi natijani yozib o‘tirmaydi, vaqtini tahlilga sarflaydi.
uz: PASCO e’loni topilmadi. Toshkentda maktablar uchun datchikli raqamli laboratoriya to‘plamlari sotiladi: masalan, geografiya/ekologiya to‘plami — 15 985 569 so‘m (U VENDOR).

videolar.izoh: Datchik bilan tajriba o‘tkazish va grafik olish.

nima: Readings reach a phone or tablet in real time over Bluetooth
No cables — the lab bench stays tidy
SPARKvue software draws the graph itself
en.qayerda: In modern physics and chemistry labs: instead of a mercury thermometer, the sensor is lowered into the solution and the heating curve is drawn on screen.
ustun: A mercury thermometer shows a single number; the sensor records the whole process as a graph
Wireless — no tangle of cables and stands on the bench
mat: Law of heating: T(t) = T∞ − (T∞ − T₀) · e^(−kt)
Example: T₀ = 22 °C, T∞ = 100 °C, k = 0.01 1/s → after 60 seconds T ≈ 57.2 °C. The graph the sensor draws is exactly this exponential.
en.foyda: Students do not spend time writing down readings and can spend it on analysis.
en.uz: No PASCO listing was found. Sensor-based digital lab kits for schools are sold in Tashkent: for example, a geography/ecology kit at 15,985,569 soums (U VENDOR).
videolar: Running an experiment with the sensor and obtaining a graph.
